final: WITH filtered_telescopes AS (SELECT t.*, o.weathprofile FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86), group_stats AS (SELECT observstation, weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM filtered_telescopes GROUP BY observstation, weathprofile) SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as avg_of_group_averages, AVG(telescope_count) as avg_of_group_counts FROM group_stats
